scope: Decode GDN M=1 structural state-flow and BF16 encoder audit

candidate_family.phase_boundary: one out-of-place bitwise transpose at Prefill-to-Decode; never per token
ordered_arithmetic_contract: prediction advances key 0..127 with the original scalar FMA order
update and result advance key 0..127 with the original scalar FMA order
no partial dot reduction, MMA, tensor core, or MTP
state and raw GDN output retain the BF16 boundary before fused RMSNorm/SiLU gate

correctness.canonical_transposed_round_trip: bitwise pass over all 786432 state words
correctness.multistep: three in-place recurrence steps bitwise matched production state and output

coverage: all 65536 BF16 bit patterns expanded to FP32
low halves 0x7fff, 0x8000, and 0x8001 for every FP32 high half
65536 deterministic full-width random FP32 bit patterns
native_encoder_equivalence.result: native BF16 RNE plus explicit NaN override matched the integer encoder bitwise

phase_transpose.boundary_rule: transpose back only if a later Prefill continuation requires canonical state

resident_screen.purpose: directional mechanism check only; not promotion evidence
resident_screen.interpretation: large resident gains disappear when 24 independent states exceed L2; they cannot support production promotion

method.gate: every paired round >=1.0 and median paired speedup >=1.2448

interpretation: one full state pass is 49152 sectors, so approximately the entire second state read hit L1
the double-read failure is not caused by the second pass falling through to L2
the cold first pass with only four state-work warps per CTA exposes latency and leaves too few eligible warps
the cooperative-load variant serializes cold loading behind a block barrier and performs still worse

calibrated_structural_bound.conclusion: current-layout BF16 shared transpose or register/warp transpose has no credible margin after shuffle, transpose, accumulator-baton, or transaction costs

decision.reason: all cold-state structural candidates regress and the isolated native encoder also regresses; resident-only wins are non-production cache artifacts

priority_after_rejection: Run a decode-wide global traffic audit before opening another GDN micro-kernel candidate.
Do not use per-token state transpose or explicit L2 persistence for all 72 MiB of layer states; the payload exceeds 4 MiB L2 and the second intra-kernel read already hits L1.
Revisit SSM state update only with a mechanism that preserves at least 24 useful state-work warps per SM without adding a phase barrier or global transaction amplification.
Prefer cross-kernel/core-flow reductions with a quantified whole-token benefit above 0.30 ms before implementation.
